description: Call when you need a cheap reachability/health check before a heavier fetch. Probes a public http(s) URL (HEAD, GET fallback): status, final URL, content-type, timing. No full body download (GET peeks ≤8KB). SSRF-safe public hosts only. Not for authenticated or private network URLs. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.

method.description: Prefer HEAD (default); GET peeks at most 8KB
